disposition_meanings.replace: Old presentation must be deleted/rebuilt against DESIGN.md; residual glyphs alone are not parity.
disposition_meanings.rework: Keep file/module boundary if useful, but rewrite observable anatomy, geometry, and choreography to the measured contract.
disposition_meanings.retain-seam-only: Keep Harness data/projection/intent/stack seams; do not treat current painting as reference-correct.
disposition_meanings.retain-with-reference-proof: Only when L2–L5 evidence proves the module already matches the frozen reference (none yet).
